name.description: Unique label for this node in the tree, at least within its parent.

width.description: Width of this node in [0..1] relative to its parent width.

attrs.description: Attributes to be displayed with this node.

title:
Hierarchical representation of consumption of any resource. The width at each level of the tree is in the range
[0..1] relative to its parent. This leads to a natural presentation as an icicle chart or other tree visualization.
name: StackTree
